children: Xfinity Mobile and Comcast Business Mobile will offer Apple’s latest products, including iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Customers will be able to pre-order iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max beginning at 8:00 am ET on Saturday, September 12, with availability beginning Friday, September 18. Pre-orders for iPhone Duo begin Friday, October 16, with availability beginning Friday, October 23.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:

New and existing Xfinity Mobile and Comcast Business Mobile customers with a Mobile Plus line can get iPhone 18 Pro Max on us with an eligible trade-in. Those customers can also get up to $1,300 off any new iPhone model with an eligible trade-in.
Mobile Plus customers who do not have a trade-in can get $400 off the latest iPhone lineup.
Xfinity Mobile: A new model for wireless
Xfinity Mobile brings together 23 million WiFi hotspots and the nation’s most reliable 5G network to deliver fast, consistent performance.
With the

plan, customers get premium features without the premium prices or hidden fees, including lifetime device protection, device upgrades every year, and unlimited data in 215+ destinations, all included for just $45/month. Customers can estimate their savings using the
Xfinity also offers Mobile Select plans for $30/month designed for customers who want essential features without sacrificing unlimited data, global travel access, and fast speeds.
For complete pricing and availability details, please visit Xfinity Mobile and Comcast Business Mobile.
Built for Business with Comcast Business Mobile

Comcast Business Mobile brings the same device lineup and offers to small businesses, running on America's best mobile network, exclusively for Comcast Business Internet customers. Businesses choose between two unlimited plans and can mix-and-match across lines, switching anytime:
Pro:

unlimited high-speed data with priority during congestion, 4K UHD video, and 40 GB of 5G LTE hotspot. Pro lines include Elite Upgrade, which lets a business swap devices up to twice in a twelve-month period while Comcast covers the balance on the old one, plus device protection through Xfinity Mobile Care as part of the plan.
Standard:
50 GB of high-speed data per line and HD video, starting at $20 per line per month.1 Device protection through Xfinity Mobile Care is available starting at $9 per month.

Both plans include unlimited talk and text plus 10 GB of high-speed data across 215+ destinations, access to millions of WiFi hotspots, and no annual contract. Businesses can add up to 20 lines. Customers can learn more at business.comcast.com/mobile.
New Comcast Business Mobile customers who add two (2) Pro lines will receive a $1,600 prepaid gift card and then $800/Pro line up to 5 lines.2
The latest iPhone models
iPhone Duo

is the first foldable iPhone, featuring a breakthrough design that’s beautiful, versatile, and durable. iPhone Duo opens to a large 7.6-inch inner display for viewing content, gaming, and multitasking, and closes to a compact, pocketable 5.4-inch outer display. Built to last with an innovative hardware design and precision hinge, iPhone Duo is powered by A20 Pro to deliver pro performance and impressive all-day battery life, and offers an advanced camera system, with the folding design unlocking fun new ways to use the camera that aren’t possible on any other iPhone. iOS 27 is also reimagined for the versatile ways users can interact with iPhone Duo.
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max

offer the new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture, the most advanced camera Apple has ever made, and new Pro controls let users customize their experience. Powered by A20 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max deliver huge leaps in battery life and performance. iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models feature Apple Intelligence3 and Siri AI4, an entirely new version of Siri, rolling out in beta in English with iOS 27, to bring AI capabilities together with a user’s personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at the core. iPhone Duo is available in two refined colors: star white and night sky. iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are available in four elegant finishes: black, silver, glacier, and an all-new burgundy.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models feature eSIM5, offering greater flexibility, better security, seamless connectivity compared to traditional physical SIM cards, and more battery life on eSIM-only models. iPhone Duo features an eSIM-only design that saves internal space to maximize battery capacity while eSIM-only models of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max take advantage of the space formerly occupied by the physical SIM with a larger battery that provides two additional hours of video playback.
For more details on Apple products, please visit www.apple.com.
About Comcast Corporation

Comcast Corporation (Nasdaq: CMCSA) is a global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, our businesses reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. We deliver world-class broadband, wireless, and video through Xfinity, Comcast Business, and Sky; produce, distribute, and stream leading entertainment, sports, and news through brands including NBC, Telemundo, Universal, Peacock, and Sky; and bring incredible theme parks and attractions to life through Universal Destinations & Experiences. Visit www.comcastcorporation.com for more information.

Use of these features is subject to Apple Intelligence terms and conditions. Learn more at apple.com/apple-intelligence. Siri AI is not available for users under 13.
